name: devharness

tools.name: connection
tools.description: Launch, attach to, list, switch, rename and close debugger connections. Actions: launch (start Chrome, or open a tab in the Chrome already on `port`, and connect), attach (connect to a running Chrome or Node.js debugger), list (every connection, with its page), switch (make a connection active and select its page), rename, close (the last connection to a Chrome kills that Chrome), status (one connection's debugger state), browsers (the Chrome processes this session launched)

connection.description: The connection, 3 descriptive words. launch/attach: the name it is created under, which later calls pass (launch defaults to "unnamed-connection-default"). switch/rename/close/status: the one to act on

newName.description: rename: the new name, 3 descriptive words

reason.description: close: why the connection is closed

url.description: launch: URL to open (default: blank page)

port.description: launch: debugging port (default: this session's reserved port); a Chrome already on it gets a tab. attach: debugger port (Node.js usually 9229)

autoConnect.description: launch: connect the debugger after launch (default: true)

forceNewInstance.description: launch: a fresh Chrome process, never a tab in an existing one

newContextWindow.description: launch: a window in the Chrome on `port` with cookies and storage of its own; with proxy, only it routes through the proxy

copyCookiesFrom.description: launch with newContextWindow: the connection whose cookies the new window starts with

bringToFront.description: launch/switch: select this tab and raise Chrome, taking keyboard focus (default: false)

width.description: launch: viewport width in CSS px

height.description: launch: viewport height in CSS px

profile.description: launch: named persistent Chrome profile, e.g. "device-a", whose storage survives across runs

proxy.description: launch: route this browser through an intercepting proxy, so a response or socket frame can be held and served in its place (default: false)

chromeArgs.description: launch: extra Chrome command-line flags, merged after the managed defaults

watchInput.description: launch: record a person's clicks and typing in this browser into History and onto the next reply, as the bench's RECORD MY INPUT does (default: replay.watchPersonInput)

tools.name: browser
tools.description: The Chrome processes this session launched. Actions: kill (end a Chrome process and every connection in it; every one this session launched when no port is given), resetLauncher (forget every Chrome this session launched)

reason.description: Why the browser is killed or the launcher reset

port.description: kill: the Chrome to kill (default: every Chrome this session launched)

tools.name: breakpoint
tools.description: Manage breakpoints and logpoints. Actions: set (line breakpoint), remove (remove by ID), list (list all), setLogpoint (log without pausing), validate (test expressions), resetCounter (reset logpoint counter), waitForScript (wait for script load), setDOMBreakpoint (pause when element changes), setEventBreakpoint (pause when event fires), setXHRBreakpoint (pause on network requests), await (set breakpoint and wait for hit - user can abort)

tools.name: execution
tools.description: Control execution flow when paused at breakpoints. Actions: pause (stop at the next statement the page runs), resume (resume execution), stepOver (step to next line), stepInto (step into function call), stepOut (step out of current function), acknowledge (acknowledge breakpoint pause to allow other tools to run while paused)

connection.description: The connection, by the name connection launch or attach gave it; acknowledge without one covers every paused connection

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Inspect and debug code. Actions: getCallStack (get call stack when paused), getVariables (get variables in call frame), evaluateExpression (evaluate JavaScript, in the page or inside a worker via `target`), searchCode (search code by pattern), searchFunctions (find function definitions), listTargets (list service/dedicated/shared worker targets)

connection.description: The connection, by the name connection launch or attach gave it

callFrameId.description: Call frame ID (getVariables: required; evaluateExpression: the frame to evaluate in)

filter.description: getVariables: regex on variable names, across all scopes

expression.description: evaluateExpression: the JavaScript; a returned Promise is awaited

awaitPromise.description: evaluateExpression: await a returned Promise (default: true); false returns the Promise itself

target.description: evaluateExpression: worker target id from listTargets, or a substring of its URL; omitted, the page

saveAs.description: Sequence step only (evaluateExpression): stores the value for later {{var:name}} / {{var:name.path}} use

isRegex.description: searchCode: pattern is a regex (default: true)

tools.name: source
tools.description: Read source code and load source maps. Actions: get (a script's code over a line range, 10 lines from startLine when endLine is omitted), loadMaps (register the .js.map files in a directory and its subdirectories; each loads when first needed), search (the original sources the maps carry, as file:line:column; with none registered, build, dist, out, .next and lib are registered first)

pattern.description: search: what to find in the original sources

isRegex.description: search: pattern is a regex (default true)

urlFilter.description: search: only sources whose path contains this

directory.description: loadMaps: the directory whose .js.map files, subdirectories included, are registered

connection.description: get: the connection, by the name connection launch or attach gave it

tools.name: console
tools.description: Monitor and manage console messages, from the page or from a worker via `target`. Actions: list, get, recent, search, clear, setObjectDepth

connection.description: The connection, by the name connection launch or attach gave it

type.description: Message type filter (log, error, warn, etc.)

target.description: Worker target id from inspect listTargets, or a URL substring; its output is held from first attach on

full.description: get: the whole message, untruncated (default false)

textLimit.description: Max characters to return from text

argsIndex.description: Specific args array index to return

reason.description: Why console needs clearing (required for clear)

tools.name: network
tools.description: Network traffic of a browser connection. Actions: list (requests, filtered and paged), get (one request by ID), search (requests by regex), enable, disable (monitoring), setConditions (throttling preset), sockets (WebSocket opens, closes, errors and frames), streams (EventSource messages)

connection.description: The connection, by the name connection launch or attach gave it

includeBody.description: get: save the response body to disk and return its path (default false)

since.description: list/sockets/streams: epoch ms; only traffic started at or after this

until.description: list/sockets/streams: epoch ms; only traffic started before this

frames.description: sockets/streams: include each one's frame or event log, oldest first, payloads truncated (default false)

socketUrl.description: sockets/streams: only those whose URL contains this substring

tools.name: proxy
tools.description: Read and steer the intercepting proxy a browser was launched through. Actions: status, events (what crossed the boundary, newest last), sockets (what each socket did: reply or push), body (one event's kept payload), answer (a URL answered with a value in place of the server), answerFrame (a socket message replaced or dropped), withdraw (an answer), answers (the ones in force), refuse (unmatched writes answered 403, or forwarded), stop (drop the proxy under this name). Holding traffic in time is the hold tool.

connection.description: The browser, by the name connection({ action: 'launch', proxy: true }) gave it

since.description: events: epoch ms, at or after

id.description: body: the event id. withdraw: the answer id

urlIncludes.description: events: only URLs containing this. answer/answerFrame: the URL substring the answer applies to

step.description: answer/answerFrame: only while this 0-based replay step is in flight

unmatchedWrites.description: refuse: an unmatched POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE is refused (403, recorded) or forwarded (default)

contentType.description: answer: content-type to answer with (default application/json)

value.description: answer: the body to answer with. answerFrame: the message sent in its place; omitted, it is dropped

textIncludes.description: answerFrame: substring of the message payload that selects it

direction.description: answerFrame: only messages going this way

tools.name: hold
tools.description: Stop the driven app at one moment across its layers - code, screen, traffic - step it, and let it run. Actions: hold (stop the layers), step (move one held layer on by its unit), release (let the layers run), status (what is held, where each stands, what waits at the proxy)

connection.description: The connection, by the name connection launch gave it

layers.description: hold/release: which layers; all of them by default. ui carries code with it

layer.description: step: code moves one statement, ui one callback, network one message

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate and control browser pages. Actions: goto (navigate to URL), reload (reload page), back (navigate back), forward (navigate forward), info (get page information)

connection.description: The connection, by the name connection launch or attach gave it

url.description: URL to navigate to (required for goto action)

waitUntil.description: goto/reload: when navigation counts as complete (default load)

ignoreCache.description: reload: clear the cache first (default false)

tools.name: dom
tools.description: Inspect and query the DOM. Actions: querySelector (find element by CSS selector and get basic info), getProperties (get detailed properties of an element), snapshot (get full DOM structure snapshot), hitTest (for every match, whether it is topmost at its own centre and what covers it when not)

connection.description: The connection, by the name connection launch or attach gave it

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Visual verification only. Use extractText for content. Actions: fullPage (full page screenshot), viewport (viewport screenshot), element (element screenshot), pdf (print to PDF with Chrome or WeasyPrint engines)

tools.name: input
tools.description: Browser input. Actions: click, type (selector, or the focused element), press (a key or combo, e.g. Meta+a), hover, focus, focusNext/focusPrevious (Tab/Shift+Tab), drag (from/to), scroll (wheel at x/y), mousemove, pinch (zoom gesture), tap (real touch, selector or x/y), swipe (real touch drag, selector + direction or from/to, for gestures a mouse cannot drive)

expect.description: click/type/hover: the element meant, as a fingerprint; another element is not acted on

append.description: Append text instead of replacing (default: false)

direction.description: swipe: direction across `selector`'s box, read at run time; in a list it holds where from/to drift with the rows above

distance.description: swipe: travel px (default 60% of the element, capped at 96px, a reveal nudge; further can commit a row's destructive action)

durationMs.description: swipe: gesture ms across `steps` (default 300); a short one is a flick, which can commit a row's destructive action. scroll: ms across `steps` (default 16 per event)

decay.description: scroll: each event's delta times this over the previous one (default 1); 0.85 over 20 steps is a momentum tail

tools.name: content
tools.description: Primary tool for page content; prefer over screenshots. Actions: extractText (page text as outline, full or one section), findInteractive (links, buttons, inputs), verify (UI checks: dead buttons, viewport, touch targets, clipping), parse (a page-parser plugin from .devharness/parsers/)

connection.description: The connection, by the name connection launch or attach gave it

mode.description: extractText: outline (headings and metadata), full (entire page), section (one section by heading)

checks.description: verify: handlers (dead buttons), viewport (position), touch (target size), overflow (clipping), clickability (z-index blocking, slow), links (dead hrefs), scroll (horizontal). Default: all but clickability

name.description: parse: plugin name; omitted, lists the plugins

waitMs.description: parse: max ms to wait for the plugin's waitFor predicate (default 8000; 0 skips)

tools.name: modal
tools.description: Blocking modals and overlays, and browser dialogs. Actions: detect (an open alert/confirm/prompt/file picker, else page overlays with the strategies each can be dismissed by), dismiss (dismiss a page overlay, the topmost by default), answer (close an open alert/confirm/prompt or fill a file picker), wait (until the open dialog closes, however it is answered)

connection.description: The connection, by the name connection launch or attach gave it

includeBackdrops.description: detect/dismiss: include backdrop/overlay elements; the same options keep detect's index valid for dismiss

selector.description: dismiss: CSS selector of the modal to dismiss

strategy.description: dismiss: accept, reject, close (click that button), remove (from the DOM), auto (by modal type; default)

accept.description: answer: OK (true, default) or Cancel (false); false closes a file picker unfilled

promptText.description: answer: the text a prompt is accepted with

files.description: answer: files for the file picker, absolute or relative to the project

timeoutMs.description: wait: most ms to wait for the dialog to close (default 600000)

tools.name: bench
tools.description: Open the bench beside a driven app: hold the page still, read what crossed its boundary and what caused each thing, record and step sequences, and collect element-level comments. Actions: start (the page running, the picker idle), hold/release (the whole page, with the bench left open), picker (armed or disarmed), tick (run a held page forward by steps or budgetMs), stop (release the page and close), keepStep/dropStep/flagStep (settle a recorded step), sweep (note captures no sequence cites), retake (a capture's region again, compared), capture (a capture file's record and element facts), list, status.

connection.description: The connection, by the name connection launch or attach gave it

steps.description: tick: callbacks to run before holding again (default 1)

budgetMs.description: tick: in place of steps, run callbacks until at least this much page time has passed

armed.description: picker: true arms Chrome's element picker, false disarms it so clicks reach the app

remove.description: sweep: delete what it reports (default: report only)

url.description: start: navigate here first; with no browser on this connection name, one is launched at it

sequence.description: start: open the pane with this sequence selected

openTab.description: start: false starts the bench with no tab of its own, for a bench tab already open to move to (default true)

reason.description: flagStep: one short line naming what is wrong, the headline the person reads first

detail.description: flagStep: an optional second line of context under the headline

selector.description: a selector that would work here

note.description: what makes this one hold up, in a few words

options.description: flagStep: selectors checked against the page, one row each, for the person to lock in with one click

step.description: start: with sequence, run it to this 0-based step and hold there

capture.description: retake/capture: path of a capture file, any version of its series

against.description: retake: the version to compare with (default 1)

saveAs.description: Sequence step only (start): stores { url } of the bench page for later steps as {{var:name.url}}

tools.name: storage
tools.description: Browser storage: cookies (getCookies, setCookie), localStorage and sessionStorage (get, set and remove each; a get without key reads the whole store), IndexedDB (idbListDatabases, idbListStores, idbGet, idbGetAll, idbPut, idbDelete), clear, writes (the localStorage and sessionStorage writes as they happened), and a virtual WebAuthn authenticator answering passkey prompts (authenticatorAdd, authenticatorCredentials, authenticatorRemove).

connection.description: The connection, by the name connection launch or attach gave it

since.description: writes: epoch ms; only writes at or after this

until.description: writes: epoch ms; only writes before this

url.description: getCookies: the URL to read cookies for

key.description: Storage or IndexedDB key; omitted on get*Storage, the whole store

record.description: idbPut: the JSON-expressible value to write

userVerified.description: authenticatorAdd: report the user verified (default true)

types.description: clear: types to clear (default cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage; indexedDB only when listed)

tools.name: download
tools.description: Download a file from a URL into the downloads directory; a suspicious file goes to quarantine instead

tools.name: request
tools.description: An HTTP request as a sequence step: node sends it from the server process (no browser, cookies or CORS); browser runs fetch() inside a connected tab (its cookies, session and origin).

body.description: Raw request body, e.g. a JSON string

destination.description: Where the request is sent from

connection.description: browser destination: the tab that runs the fetch

saveAs.description: Sequence step only: stores {ok,status,statusText,headers,body,durationMs} for later {{var:name.path}} use

tools.name: assert
tools.description: Assert a condition as a sequence step; a false one fails the step and stops the run. Value form: left + operator + right, typically {{var:...}} values a prior step captured. DOM form: selector + condition, polled until it holds.

expect.description: selector: the element meant, as a fingerprint; another element is refused with a repair

left.description: Value form: the value to check, typically a {{var:name.path}} template

operator.description: Comparison; value form, and the text/attribute/count conditions

right.description: What it is compared with; unused by exists/notExists

selector.description: DOM form: CSS selector, polled until the condition holds. Supports :has-text("x")

condition.description: present | visible (non-zero box) | hittable (nothing covers its centre) | absent | text | attribute | count (these three with operator/right) | enabled

connection.description: DOM form: which browser; a run supplies its own

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Wait as a sequence step for async work a previous step started. Exactly one of: selector (appears), selectorGone (disappears), expression (synchronous JS turns truthy), ms (fixed sleep). Polls from outside the page, so it survives navigation.

expect.description: selector: the element meant, as a fingerprint; another element is refused with a repair

selector.description: Until an element matches this CSS selector; :has-text("x") partial, :text("x") exact

selectorGone.description: Until NO element matches this selector (spinner removed, modal closed)

expression.description: Until this SYNCHRONOUS JavaScript expression is truthy; no await

ms.description: Fixed sleep ms, a last resort

timeoutMs.description: Give up after this many ms (default 15000); the step then fails

pollIntervalMs.description: Interval between condition checks in ms (default: 100)

connection.description: selector/selectorGone/expression: the connection; a run supplies its own

tools.name: check
tools.description: Check one thing, answering held or failed: an element (selector + condition), a value ({{var:...}} + operator + right), a JS expression, the URL, a cookie, a localStorage key, an IndexedDB record, proxy traffic (traffic + count), a socket, a connection being open (connectionOpen), or time alone (afterMs). withinMs reads again until it holds. As a sequence step, holds/fails pick continue, stop or running another sequence.

expect.description: selector: the element meant, as a fingerprint; another element is refused with a repair

selector.description: An element to check, with `condition`. Supports :has-text("x")

condition.description: selector: present | visible | hittable (nothing covers its centre) | absent | text | attribute | count | enabled. cookie/localStorage/indexedDB: present (default) or absent. socket: open (default) or closed

value.description: A value to check, typically a {{var:name.path}} template, with `operator` and `right`

operator.description: How the value, or the element's text/attribute/count, is compared with `right`. For `url`: equals (default), contains or matches

right.description: What it is compared with. Not used for exists/notExists

expression.description: A synchronous JavaScript predicate, read in the page or a Node target

indexedDB.description: DB/STORE/KEY for one record, or DB/STORE for any record in the store

urlIncludes.description: Substring of the request's URL, or of the socket's URL for a frame

textIncludes.description: A frame: what its payload carries. A lone "key":value pair compares that top-level JSON field; anything else is a substring

traffic.description: Traffic crossing the proxy: a request by urlIncludes + method, a frame by urlIncludes + direction + textIncludes. Needs a browser launched with proxy: true

stepsBack.description: traffic: count from the start of the call this many back (default 1, the call before the check; 0, the check itself)

count.description: traffic: how many crossings, compared by operator (default gte)

socket.description: A socket whose URL carries this, with condition open (default) or closed. Needs proxy: true

connectionOpen.description: A connection of this session by name, with condition present (default: open) or absent

afterMs.description: Read nothing until this much time has passed; alone, a timer

withinMs.description: Read again until it holds, for at most this long after afterMs. 0 or omitted reads once

message.description: What a failure means, reported in its place

run.description: Name of the sequence to run

resumeAt.description: 0-based step of this sequence to resume at once it has run, forward only

holds.description: Sequence step, on hold: continue (default), stop, or { run, resumeAt }

run.description: Name of the sequence to run

resumeAt.description: 0-based step of this sequence to resume at once it has run, forward only

fails.description: Sequence step, on failure: stop (default), continue, or { run, resumeAt }

connection.description: Which browser it reads

tools.name: replay
tools.description: Record and replay tool-call sequences. Actions: history, repeat (re-run history indices), create (sequence from history indices), insert, addCheck, declare (the browsers, sockets and tags a sequence carries), repair (the step a run paused on after clicking another element), copy (steps 1..N into a new sequence), split (steps 1..N into a shared sequence the original runs), adopt (a shared sequence in place of steps 1..N of another), search (saved steps holding a string, or reaching an element), list (memory and disk), get, delete (from memory), export (to disk as sequence/playwright/puppeteer), load, listSaved, deleteSaved, run (in the background, returning a runId; wait: true blocks), runAll (every sequence in a folder, or carrying a tag, one pass/fail line each), status, cancel, step/finish (a paused run), runFromLog (log line numbers), recordInteraction (a person's mouse, keyboard and navigation through a browser overlay; blocks until that person finishes)

startUrl.description: create: sequence start URL. run: replaces the stored startUrl for this run only

envFile.description: run/runAll: KEY=value file supplying the {{env:NAME}} tokens; its values win over the server environment

baseUrl.description: run/runAll: origin every absolute URL in the run moves onto, path and query kept

params.description: repeat, one index: fields replacing the recorded ones; null removes one

runId.description: status/cancel: the background run, by the id run returned

bench.description: run: play in the bench open on connection, as its Replay button does, so it shows there

wait.description: run: block until the run completes and return the full result. Default false: return a runId at once

connection.description: The connection the steps use, e.g. "duo-member-two"

profile.description: Named persistent Chrome profile to come up on

connections.description: run: { "<recorded connection>": "<connection here>" }, rebinding a multi-connection sequence onto this session

variables.description: run/runAll: replacement text for recorded typed-text steps, keyed var_<0-based step>_<selector with non-alphanumerics as _>

tools.name: server
tools.description: Development servers. instructions:
# devharness MCP Server

Chrome DevTools Protocol debugging for JavaScript/TypeScript in Chrome, Node.js, or CDP-compatible environments - breakpoints, variable inspection, browser automation, dev server management, and record/replay verification.

**Quick start (web apps):**
1. `connection({ action: 'launch', connection: "my-web-app" })` - launches AND auto-connects, ready immediately (do not attach after this)
2. `navigate({ action: 'goto', connection: "my-web-app", url: "..." })` - also caches interactive elements for the page
3. `content({ action: 'findInteractive', connection: "my-web-app" })` / `content({ action: 'extractText', mode: 'outline', connection: "my-web-app" })` to read the page
